provisionalPathBudget.partitionRule: One implementation PR under the repository default 15-file and 1200-line budget; defects 5 and 6 close by #489 evidence rather than duplicate source changes.

ownerIntent.requestedOutcome: Complete the six preserved release, delivery, automation, current-truth, and merge-model defects under lifecycle V2 without reopening old PR authority or performing a public release.
ownerIntent.authorization: Level C source, test, read-only provider/device reconciliation, exact-diff security review, PR creation, and safe merge. Internal delivery for the separately requested #484 physical visual proof remains governed and public release is prohibited.
prohibitedOutcomes: public OTA or public App Store release
Google Play production submission or rollout expansion
production money, payouts, cashout, Stripe, or SKU activation
duplicate Apple submission or unnecessary rebuild
permanent Owner, User, or RepositoryRole bypass
committing credentials, private provider payloads, signed URLs, account identifiers, or device identifiers

nonGoals: change Chi'lly Chat or auth product behavior
create a native build or Apple/Google submission merely to exercise tooling
change database schema, migrations, RLS, auth, entitlements, money, or provider rights
bypass Apple device trust, signing, UI Automation authorization, or macOS security controls

rollback.strategy: Revert the exact source-only tooling PR, preserve signed artifacts and provider state, and retain fail-closed lifecycle and ruleset controls.

cleanup.strategy: Stop only task-created temporary local processes and retain raw device evidence outside Git; preserve Integration-only permanent ruleset bypass.

observability.strategy: Persist only redacted hashes, state classifications, exact source identities, and resumption actions without secrets or private device/provider payloads.
